mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_USER, ROLE_CODE FROM wo_workbook_member_map WHERE WORKBOOK_SEQ = #{workbookSeq} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_DATETIME IS NULL ORDER BY MEMBER_USER
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO wo_workbook_member_map T USING (SELECT CAST(#{workbookSeq} AS BIGINT) AS WORKBOOK_SEQ, CAST(#{memberUser} AS VARCHAR) AS MEMBER_USER) S ON (T.WORKBOOK_SEQ = S.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND T.MEMBER_USER = S.MEMBER_USER) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode}, USE_YN = 'Y', MOD_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, MOD_USER = #{userKey}, DEL_DATETIME = NULL, DEL_USER = NULL WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( WORKBOOK_SEQ, MEMBER_USER, ROLE_CODE, USE_YN, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES ( #{workbookSeq}, #{memberUser}, #{roleCode}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey} )

INSERT INTO wo_workbook_member_map ( WORKBOOK_SEQ, MEMBER_USER, ROLE_CODE, USE_YN, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES ( #{workbookSeq}, #{memberUser}, #{roleCode}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey} ) ON CONFLICT (WORKBOOK_SEQ, MEMBER_USER) DO UPDATE SET ROLE_CODE = EXCLUDED.ROLE_CODE, USE_YN = 'Y', MOD_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, MOD_USER = #{userKey}, DEL_DATETIME = NULL, DEL_USER = NULL
